show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/ezzseK
show.description: When a wedding in the silent village of Dhumgarh breaks an ancient taboo against noise, a curse awakens—the vengeful spirit of Dev, a once-noble scholar betrayed in love and transformed into the dreaded Brahmrakshas. As brides mysteriously vanish, Ira, a fearless paranormal expert, arrives to uncover the truth.
